exec azk init
exec azk key generate rsa --type rsa --bits 2048
exec azk key generate ec --type ec
exec azk key generate ed --type ed25519
exec azk key generate aes --type oct --bits 256

# Sign and verify with every key type, default and explicit algorithms.
exec azk sign --key rsa --in msg.txt -o rsa.sig
exec azk verify --key rsa --in msg.txt --signature @rsa.sig
stdout '^valid$'
exec azk sign --key rsa --alg PS512 --in msg.txt --raw -o rsa.raw
exec azk verify --key rsa --alg PS512 --in msg.txt --signature @rsa.raw --raw-signature
! exec azk verify --key rsa --in msg.txt --signature @rsa.raw --raw-signature
stdout '^invalid$'
! exec azk verify --key rsa --in other.txt --signature @rsa.sig
stdout invalid
exec azk --json sign --key ec --in msg.txt
stdout '"algorithm": "ES256"'
exec azk sign --key ec --in msg.txt -o ec.sig
exec azk verify --key ec --in msg.txt --signature @ec.sig
exec azk sign --key ed --in msg.txt -o ed.sig
exec azk verify --key ed --in msg.txt --signature @ed.sig
stdout valid
! exec azk sign --key aes --in msg.txt
stderr 'cannot sign'
! exec azk sign --key ec --alg RS256 --in msg.txt
stderr 'not supported'

# Encrypt/decrypt through the JSON envelope, with AAD for AES.
exec azk encrypt --key aes --aad ctx --in msg.txt -o aes.json
grep '"algorithm": "A256GCM"' aes.json
grep '"iv":' aes.json
exec azk decrypt --in aes.json
cmp stdout msg.txt
! exec azk encrypt --key aes --in msg.txt --raw
stderr 'iv and tag'
exec azk encrypt --key rsa --in msg.txt -o rsa.json
grep '"algorithm": "RSA-OAEP-256"' rsa.json
exec azk decrypt --in rsa.json
cmp stdout msg.txt
exec azk encrypt --key rsa --alg RSA1_5 --in msg.txt --raw -o rsa.bin
exec azk decrypt --key rsa --alg RSA1_5 --raw --in rsa.bin
cmp stdout msg.txt
! exec azk decrypt --in msg.txt
stderr 'not an encrypt envelope'
! exec azk encrypt --key ed --in msg.txt
stderr 'cannot encrypt'

# Wrap/unwrap: AES-KW needs 8-byte multiples, RSA takes anything small.
exec azk wrap --key aes --in key32.b64 -o w.b64
exec azk unwrap --key aes --in w.b64
cmp stdout key32.b64
exec azk wrap --key rsa --raw-in --in msg.txt --raw -o w.bin
exec azk unwrap --key rsa --raw-in --in w.bin --raw
cmp stdout msg.txt
! exec azk wrap --key aes --raw-in --in msg.txt
stderr 'multiple of 8'
! exec azk unwrap --key aes --in msg.txt
stderr 'not base64'

# Versions: a signature is tied to the version that made it.
exec azk key rotate ec
exec azk verify --key ec --version 1 --in msg.txt --signature @ec.sig
! exec azk verify --key ec --in msg.txt --signature @ec.sig
stdout invalid
exec azk key disable ec --version 2
exec azk sign --key ec --in msg.txt
! exec azk sign --key ec --version 2 --in msg.txt
stderr 'disabled'

# Expired and not-yet-valid versions are refused for private operations.
exec azk key generate old --type ec --expires 2000-01-01
! exec azk sign --key old --in msg.txt
stderr 'expired'
exec azk key generate future --type ec --not-before 2999-01-01
! exec azk sign --key future --in msg.txt
stderr 'not valid before'
! exec azk key generate bad --type ec --expires soon
stderr 'invalid time'

-- msg.txt --
the quick brown fox
-- other.txt --
the quick brown cat
-- key32.b64 --
